output.summary: Zero deviations since February coincide with a supervisor bonus penalty per deviation. Independent QC rejections and customer complaints are rising, and purchases of replacement components are up 30%. Complaints trace 71% to Line 3 lots with luer-bond leaks. The hotline report alleges unrecorded back-cage rework and borrowed technicians. Badge data confirms Line 1 and 4 technicians working in the Line 3 cell on timesheets charged elsewhere, and Line 3's per-technician productivity is flat. So Line 3 is not a transferable model, and the zero count reflects suppressed reporting. Who authorized the lending, and whether the Plant Manager knew, is unestablished. Preferred actions are an independent investigation with reporter protection and removing the penalty. Disciplining the supervisor now is premature, and identifying the reporter is harmful.
